description: For al Nahda National schools abudhabi
summary: We developed a website that kids and children that are 4-12 years old so that they explore space night sky changes, space objects with their meanings, and learn about telescopes. It addresses the challenge by explaining space objects and by making an interactive video that shows the night sky image and we added questions about the sky changes and objects in space. It is important because it teaches kids and children about the space important elements such as space objects like comets, it gives clear meanings for the space objects so that kids and children can understand, and it has levels and different detective missions that help kids and children compare and identify space objects and how the move or look like. All of the educational activities combine both fun and learning at the same time!
details: It gives kids questions and detective missions that ask them to identify space objects, and it has different levels that children and kids can choose,it has an interactive video that helps them understand meanings, plus it gives and generates certificates when kids and children complete different missions. It's benefits are that it helps kids and children use their screen time in an educational and useful way while having fun. The intended impact of our project is to encourage kids and children to learn more about Space while having fun, we don't want kids and children to be forced to learn we want them to enjoy! We used base44 to create our website and Claude to make the interactive video/game, these tools helped develop our project by making our product in a faster way, these tools are artificial intelligence tools. It contains different colors, themes, and different activities with different levels to match different age levels. The factors that our team considered are teamwork, creativity, empathy, and tolerance.
